A Credit Decision Where Outcomes Exist Only for the Approved.** Decide whether a digital lender should lower its approval cut-off when defaults are observed only for approved loans, using a randomised exploration sample, inverse-propensity weighting, decision-level bootstrap uncertainty and minimax-regret robustness, and write the recommendation memo.
